DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome.

The clinical picture of a newborn with a cardiac defect (PDA), cataracts, and sensorineural hearing loss, combined with a positive Rubella IgM and blanching macules (likely petechiae or purpura), is classic for Congenital Rubella Syndrome. No further tests are required to confirm this diagnosis.
